# Delegate to DeepSeek Harness

> Community Codex Skill for scoped, bidirectional delegation from the current Codex task to a locally running DeepSeek Harness through a loopback-only Web API and cwd-pinned file channel.

Canonical repository: https://github.com/papperrollinggery/delegate-to-deepseek-harness

## Core facts

- Project type: standalone Codex Skill plus a Python 3.10+ standard-library CLI.
- Primary use cases: copywriting, research synthesis, video-preproduction text, coding, review, and independent opinions inside larger projects.
- Non-goals: Codex subagent creation, new Codex task creation, video rendering, media editing, upload, publication, or automatic external actions.
- Harness dependency: official DeepSeek Harness Web profile; compatibility target is @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6.
- Supported models: deepseek-v4-pro and deepseek-v4-flash through deepseek-official.
- Endpoint boundary: literal loopback hosts only: 127.0.0.1, localhost, or ::1.
- Runtime Python dependencies: none outside the standard library.
- Project status: community project; not affiliated with or endorsed by OpenAI or DeepSeek.
- License: MIT License. See https://github.com/papperrollinggery/delegate-to-deepseek-harness/blob/main/LICENSE.

## Runtime artifacts

- [SKILL.md](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/delegate-to-deepseek-harness/blob/main/SKILL.md): trigger description, safety rules, task routing, and delegation loop.
- [agents/openai.yaml](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/delegate-to-deepseek-harness/blob/main/agents/openai.yaml): Codex-facing display metadata and default invocation prompt.
- [scripts/dsh_harness.py](https://github.com/papperrollinggery/delegate-to-deepseek-harness/blob/main/scripts/dsh_harness.py): deterministic loopback-only Harness RPC client.

## File-channel contract

- SCOPE.md: read/write scope and explicit limitations.
- TASK.md: bounded delegated task and output protocol.
- RESULT.md: primary result; preserve model-written content.
- OPINION.md: optional review or suggestion channel.
- ASK.md: blocking question or scope-expansion request; never auto-approve.
- STATUS.json: durable session, model, preset, scope, RPC, completion, and status data.
- .dsh-delegation-history/<run-id>/: recoverable archive of the previous run's control files when a cwd is reused; sensitive local task data, not an isolation boundary.
- REPLY.md: reserved future channel; not implemented.

## Safety interpretation

- Loopback-only transport is mandatory because the Harness Web API has no authentication boundary.
- workspace-write is a write boundary only; it does not provide read or outbound-network isolation.
- proposal-only is an instructional expected-write guardrail; the actual write boundary remains the session cwd, and it is not a read sandbox.
- delegate, run, and send prompting paths are serialized per cwd by this CLI, and unsafe overlap with other running same-directory sessions is rejected; independent UI or third-party clients are outside that lock.
- create, run, and delegate select a model and also persist the RC.6 deployment-wide default.
- The minimal preset is deliberately rejected.
